Sukhumvit and Thonglor

This is where most first stays land. BTS Nana, Asok, Phrom Phong, Thong Lo, and Ekkamai sit on one line.

RailBTS Sukhumvit line, Asok links to MRT
EatThonglor for dinner, Soi 38 for late grub
NightsSoi 11 and Thonglor sit on nightlife pages

Asok and Phrom Phong are the easiest hotels-plus-BTS pairing. Thonglor is one stop further and better for dinner. Nana is louder and cheaper.

Bar Us, Rabbit Hole, and Find The Locker Room are on the Thonglor nightlife page. Havana Social is on Sukhumvit Soi 11. They are not listed here as a crawl.

Common questions

Is Nana too noisy?
The soi itself is. Hotels a block off Sukhumvit Road are fine if you want the price and the BTS.
